title: Correcting or Continuing? What On-Policy Distillation Learns from Student Errors
abstract: arXiv:2610.18011v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: On-policy distillation (OPD) trains a student on its own rollouts under a frozen teacher, mitigating the distribution mismatch of off-policy supervision. While prior work has primarily trained on problems a student can largely solve, we ask whether OPD can improve a student when training is restricted to problems it currently fails. We evaluate five representative OPD mechanisms with Qwen-3 and Phi-4 models under a unified competition-mathematics protocol. We find that OPD does not improve accuracy on this hard subset, with most mechanisms instead degrading performance despite continued decreases in training KL divergence. All eight configurations show a decline, and the two-sided sign test gives p=0.0078. In contrast, the same pipeline improves accuracy by 4.6 percentage points when training is not concentrated on failures, showing that the failure is conditional on the training regime rather than systematic. translated_title: 纠错还是延续？在线策略蒸馏从学生错误中学到了什么
translated_abstract: 在线策略蒸馏（OPD）在冻结的教师模型下，让学生模型在其自身生成的 rollout 上进行训练，从而缓解了离策略监督带来的分布不匹配问题。以往的工作主要在学生模型基本能够解决的问题上进行训练，而我们探讨的是：当训练仅限于学生模型当前无法解决的问题时，OPD能否提升学生模型的表现。我们在统一的竞赛数学评测协议下，使用Qwen-3和Phi-4模型评估了五种具有代表性的OPD机制。我们发现，OPD在这个困难子集上并不能提升准确率，大多数机制反而导致性能下降，尽管训练过程中的KL散度持续降低。所有八种配置均出现性能下降，双侧符号检验给出p=0.0078。相比之下，当训练不集中于失败问题时，同样的流程可使准确率提升4.6个百分点，这表明这种失败取决于训练模式，是条件性的结果，而非系统性问题。
tldr: 研究发现在线策略蒸馏（OPD）在仅针对学生模型当前无法解决的难题进行训练时，不仅无法提升准确率反而导致性能普遍下降（尽管训练KL散度持续降低），而当训练不集中于失败问题时同一流程却能带来4.6个百分点的提升，说明该失败是训练模式的条件性结果而非系统性缺陷。
en_tdlr: On-policy distillation fails to improve and even degrades student performance when trained exclusively on problems the student currently fails (p=0.0078), despite decreasing training KL divergence, while the same pipeline yields a 4.6 percentage-point gain when training is not concentrated on failures—showing the failure is conditional on the training regime rather than systematic.
